svg.text: mains_inletIEC C14 panel inlet with fuse drawer and rocker switch
VBUS 12 V from PS1: load 1.55 A typical, 5.1 A peak; source 6 A cont, 6.6 A peak
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
